text: Over the 275 sessions to 28 Sep 26, the correlation between bitcoin's daily returns and the Nasdaq Composite's was 0.40 across the last 90 sessions, and 0.39 against the S&P 500. Against the Nasdaq over 252 sessions the beta is 1.18 with an R² of 0.24, so the index accounts for about 24% of the variance in bitcoin's daily returns. This is a description of the figures, not advice.
